params.1266: No Need To Cry About It
params.1273: Harvest a crop of onions from an allotment.
params.1274: To grow a crop of onions you will need three onion seeds. You can pickpocket these from Master Farmers (with sufficient Thieving) or buy them.
params.1275: Head to an allotment to plant them.
params.1276: Onions are used in Cooking and the making of dye, and can be protected while growing by the presence of marigolds.
